apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app
    spec:
      tolerations:
      - key: dedicated
        operator: Equal
        value: gpu
        effect: NoSchedule
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.31.5
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
EOF
sleep 5; kubectl get deploy app -o wide; kubectl get po -l app=app -o wide"}

message.reasoning_content: Pods scheduled. Now wait for running. Image pull could fail. Let's wait bounded ~60s.
